description: The §15 jobs registry — scheduler-neutral job definitions. `plainkeep job apply` renders launchd plists and `plainkeep job enable --all --yes` loads them into launchd (`plainkeep job status` shows which of the three states each job is in); `plainkeep job run <name>` runs any job manually (the universal fallback). Rules: jobs call ONE verb (no inline logic), only read/safe_write may be scheduled, everything logs to .logs/jobs/. JSON (not the design's YAML) to keep the core stdlib-only.
